metric: Minimum distinct identifiable live victim and compareciente speakers, including personal introductions, per supplied consolidated transcript. Attorneys are separate. Remote observers and people mentioned only as victims of an underlying crime are outside this speaker count. Repeated turns by one person within a transcript count once.
default: Each Statements / submissions record has one identified principal compareciente. Each sworn declaration has one principal witness, counted separately from comparecientes. The protective-measures record has one principal compareciente. Zero victim speakers means none identified in the rapid source review; it is not a count of audience attendance.
